segments.thag19.1:1.3: Aniccato sabbabhavaṃ vipassaṃ, taṃ me idaṃ taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
segments.thag19.1:2.1: “Kadā nuhaṃ bhinnapaṭandharo muni, kāsāvavattho amamo nirāso;
segments.thag19.1:2.3: Rāgañca dosañca tatheva mohaṃ, hantvā sukhī pavanagato vihassaṃ.
segments.thag19.1:3.3: Vipassamāno vītabhayo vihassaṃ, eko vane taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
segments.thag19.1:4.3: Paññāmayaṃ tikhiṇamasiṃ gahetvā, chetvā vase tampi kadā bhavissati.
segments.thag19.1:5.3: Māraṃ sasenaṃ sahasā bhañjissaṃ, sīhāsane taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
segments.thag19.1:6.1: “Kadā nuhaṃ sabbhi samāgamesu, diṭṭho bhave dhammagarūhi tādibhi;
segments.thag19.1:6.3: Yāthāvadassīhi jitindriyehi, padhāniyo taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
segments.thag19.1:7.1: “Kadā nu maṃ tandi khudā pipāsā, vātātapā kīṭasarīsapā vā;
segments.thag19.1:7.3: Na bādhayissanti na taṃ giribbaje, atthatthiyaṃ taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
segments.thag19.1:8.1: “Kadā nu kho yaṃ viditaṃ mahesinā, cattāri saccāni sududdasāni;
segments.thag19.1:8.3: Samāhitatto satimā agacchaṃ, paññāya taṃ taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
segments.thag19.1:9.1: “Kadā nu rūpe amite ca sadde, gandhe rase phusitabbe ca dhamme;
segments.thag19.1:9.3: Ādittatohaṃ samathehi yutto, paññāya dacchaṃ tadidaṃ kadā me.
segments.thag19.1:10.1: “Kadā nuhaṃ dubbacanena vutto, tatonimittaṃ vimano na hessaṃ;
segments.thag19.1:10.3: Atho pasatthopi tatonimittaṃ, tuṭṭho na hessaṃ tadidaṃ kadā me.
segments.thag19.1:11.1: “Kadā nu kaṭṭhe ca tiṇe latā ca, khandhe imehaṃ amite ca dhamme;
segments.thag19.1:11.3: Ajjhattikāneva ca bāhirāni ca, samaṃ tuleyyaṃ tadidaṃ kadā me.
segments.thag19.1:12.1: “Kadā nu maṃ pāvusakālamegho, navena toyena sacīvaraṃ vane;
segments.thag19.1:12.3: Isippayātamhi pathe vajantaṃ, ovassate taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
segments.thag19.1:13.1: “Kadā mayūrassa sikhaṇḍino vane, dijassa sutvā girigabbhare rutaṃ;
segments.thag19.1:13.3: Paccuṭṭhahitvā amatassa pattiyā, saṃcintaye taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
segments.thag19.1:14.1: “Kadā nu gaṅgaṃ yamunaṃ sarassatiṃ, pātālakhittaṃ vaḷavāmukhañca [balavāmukhañca (ka.)];
segments.thag19.1:14.3: Asajjamāno patareyyamiddhiyā, vibhiṃsanaṃ taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
segments.thag19.1:15.1: “Kadā nu nāgova asaṅgacārī, padālaye kāmaguṇesu chandaṃ;
segments.thag19.1:15.3: Nibbajjayaṃ sabbasubhaṃ nimittaṃ, jhāne yuto taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
segments.thag19.1:16.1: “Kadā iṇaṭṭova daliddako [daḷiddako (sī.)] nidhiṃ, ārādhayitvā dhanikehi pīḷito;
segments.thag19.1:16.3: Tuṭṭho bhavissaṃ adhigamma sāsanaṃ, mahesino taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
segments.thag19.1:17.1: “Bahūni vassāni tayāmhi yācito,‘agāravāsena alaṃ nu te idaṃ’;
segments.thag19.1:17.3: Taṃ dāni maṃ pabbajitaṃ samānaṃ, kiṃkāraṇā citta tuvaṃ na yuñjasi.
segments.thag19.1:18.1: “Nanu ahaṃ citta tayāmhi yācito,‘giribbaje citrachadā vihaṅgamā’;
segments.thag19.1:18.3: Mahindaghosatthanitābhigajjino, te taṃ ramessanti vanamhi jhāyinaṃ.
segments.thag19.1:19.1: “Kulamhi mitte ca piye ca ñātake, khiḍḍāratiṃ kāmaguṇañca loke;
segments.thag19.1:19.3: Sabbaṃ pahāya imamajjhupāgato, athopi tvaṃ citta na mayha tussasi.
segments.thag19.1:20.1: “Mameva etaṃ na hi tvaṃ paresaṃ, sannāhakāle paridevitena kiṃ;
segments.thag19.1:20.3: Sabbaṃ idaṃ calamiti pekkhamāno, abhinikkhamiṃ amatapadaṃ jigīsaṃ.
segments.thag19.1:22.1: “Kāmā hi citrā madhurā manoramā, aviddasū yattha sitā puthujjanā;
segments.thag19.1:22.3: Te dukkhamicchanti punabbhavesino, cittena nītā niraye nirākatā.
segments.thag19.1:23.3: Kāye apekkhaṃ jaha mā virādhaya’, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
segments.thag19.1:24.1: “‘Bhāvehi jhānāni ca indriyāni ca, balāni bojjhaṅgasamādhibhāvanā;
segments.thag19.1:24.3: Tisso ca vijjā phusa buddhasāsane’, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
segments.thag19.1:25.3: Aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ sabbakilesasodhanaṃ’, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
segments.thag19.1:26.1: “‘Dukkhanti khandhe paṭipassa yoniso, yato ca dukkhaṃ samudeti taṃ jaha;
segments.thag19.1:26.3: Idheva dukkhassa karohi antaṃ’, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
segments.thag19.1:27.1: “‘Aniccaṃ dukkhanti vipassa yoniso, suññaṃ anattāti aghaṃ vadhanti ca;
segments.thag19.1:27.3: Manovicāre uparundha cetaso’, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
segments.thag19.1:28.3: Yuñjassu satthuvacane mahesino’, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
segments.thag19.1:29.3: Cando yathā dosinapuṇṇamāsiyā’, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
segments.thag19.1:30.1: “‘Āraññiko hohi ca piṇḍapātiko, sosāniko hohi ca paṃsukūliko;
segments.thag19.1:30.3: Nesajjiko hohi sadā dhute rato’, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
segments.thag19.1:31.1: “Ropetva rukkhāni yathā phalesī, mūle taruṃ chettu tameva icchasi;
segments.thag19.1:31.3: Tathūpamaṃ cittamidaṃ karosi, yaṃ maṃ aniccamhi cale niyuñjasi.
segments.thag19.1:32.1: “Arūpa dūraṅgama ekacāri, na te karissaṃ vacanaṃ idānihaṃ;
segments.thag19.1:32.3: Dukkhā hi kāmā kaṭukā mahabbhayā, nibbānamevābhimano carissaṃ.
segments.thag19.1:33.1: “Nāhaṃ alakkhyā ahirikkatāya vā, na cittahetū na ca dūrakantanā;
segments.thag19.1:33.3: Ājīvahetū ca ahaṃ na nikkhamiṃ, kato ca te citta paṭissavo mayā.
segments.thag19.1:34.3: Itissu maṃ citta tadā niyuñjasi, idāni tvaṃ gacchasi pubbaciṇṇaṃ.
segments.thag19.1:35.1: “Taṇhā avijjā ca piyāpiyañca, subhāni rūpāni sukhā ca vedanā;
segments.thag19.1:35.3: Manāpiyā kāmaguṇā ca vantā, vante ahaṃ āvamituṃ na ussahe.
segments.thag19.1:36.1: “Sabbattha te citta vaco kataṃ mayā, bahūsu jātīsu na mesi kopito;
segments.thag19.1:36.3: Ajjhattasambhavo kataññutāya te, dukkhe ciraṃ saṃsaritaṃ tayā kate.
segments.thag19.1:37.1: “Tvaññeva no citta karosi brāhmaṇo [brāhmaṇe (sī.), brāhmaṇaṃ (?) bhāvalopa-tappadhānatā gahetabbā], tvaṃ khattiyo rājadasī [rājadisī (syā. ka.)] karosi;
segments.thag19.1:37.3: Vessā ca suddā ca bhavāma ekadā, devattanaṃ vāpi taveva vāhasā.
segments.thag19.1:38.1: “Taveva hetū asurā bhavāmase, tvaṃmūlakaṃ nerayikā bhavāmase;
segments.thag19.1:38.3: Atho tiracchānagatāpi ekadā, petattanaṃ vāpi taveva vāhasā.
segments.thag19.1:39.1: “Nanu dubbhissasi maṃ punappunaṃ, muhuṃ muhuṃ cāraṇikaṃva dassayaṃ;
segments.thag19.1:39.3: Ummattakeneva mayā palobhasi, kiñcāpi te citta virādhitaṃ mayā.
segments.thag19.1:40.1: “Idaṃ pure cittamacāri cārikaṃ, yenicchakaṃ yatthakāmaṃ yathāsukhaṃ;
segments.thag19.1:40.3: Tadajjahaṃ niggahessāmi yoniso, hatthippabhinnaṃ viya aṅkusaggaho.
segments.thag19.1:41.1: “Satthā ca me lokamimaṃ adhiṭṭhahi, aniccato addhuvato asārato;
segments.thag19.1:41.3: Pakkhanda maṃ citta jinassa sāsane, tārehi oghā mahatā suduttarā.
segments.thag19.1:42.1: “Na te idaṃ citta yathā purāṇakaṃ, nāhaṃ alaṃ tuyha vase nivattituṃ [vasena vattituṃ (?)];
segments.thag19.1:42.3: Mahesino pabbajitomhi sāsane, na mādisā honti vināsadhārino.
segments.thag19.1:43.1: “Nagā samuddā saritā vasundharā, disā catasso vidisā adho divā;
segments.thag19.1:43.3: Sabbe aniccā tibhavā upaddutā, kuhiṃ gato citta sukhaṃ ramissasi.
segments.thag19.1:44.1: “Dhitipparaṃ kiṃ mama citta kāhisi, na te alaṃ citta vasānuvattako;
segments.thag19.1:44.3: Na jātu bhastaṃ ubhatomukhaṃ chupe, dhiratthu pūraṃ nava sotasandaniṃ.
segments.thag19.1:46.3: Sumañjughosatthanitābhigajjino, te taṃ ramessanti vanamhi jhāyinaṃ.
segments.thag19.1:47.1: “Vuṭṭhamhi deve caturaṅgule tiṇe, saṃpupphite meghanibhamhi kānane;
segments.thag19.1:47.3: Nagantare viṭapisamo sayissaṃ, taṃ me mudū hehiti tūlasannibhaṃ.
segments.thag19.1:48.1: “Tathā tu kassāmi yathāpi issaro, yaṃ labbhati tenapi hotu me alaṃ;
segments.thag19.1:48.3: Na tāhaṃ kassāmi yathā atandito, biḷārabhastaṃva yathā sumadditaṃ.
segments.thag19.1:49.1: “Tathā tu kassāmi yathāpi issaro, yaṃ labbhati tenapi hotu me alaṃ;
segments.thag19.1:49.3: Vīriyena taṃ mayha vasānayissaṃ, gajaṃva mattaṃ kusalaṅkusaggaho.
segments.thag19.1:50.1: “Tayā sudantena avaṭṭhitena hi, hayena yoggācariyova ujjunā;
segments.thag19.1:50.3: Pahomi maggaṃ paṭipajjituṃ sivaṃ, cittānurakkhīhi sadā nisevitaṃ.
segments.thag19.1:51.1: “Ārammaṇe taṃ balasā nibandhisaṃ, nāgaṃva thambhamhi daḷhāya rajjuyā;
segments.thag19.1:51.3: Taṃ me suguttaṃ satiyā subhāvitaṃ, anissitaṃ sabbabhavesu hehisi.
segments.thag19.1:52.1: “Paññāya chetvā vipathānusārinaṃ, yogena niggayha pathe nivesiya;
segments.thag19.1:52.3: Disvā samudayaṃ vibhavañca sambhavaṃ, dāyādako hehisi aggavādino.
segments.thag19.1:54.1: “Migo yathā seri sucittakānane, rammaṃ giriṃ pāvusaabbhamāliniṃ [māliṃ (?)];
segments.thag19.1:54.3: Anākule tattha nage ramissaṃ [ramissasi (syā. ka.)], asaṃsayaṃ citta parā bhavissasi.
segments.thag19.1:55.1: “Ye tuyha chandena vasena vattino, narā ca nārī ca anubhonti yaṃ sukhaṃ;
segments.thag19.1:55.3: Aviddasū māravasānuvattino, bhavābhinandī tava citta sāvakā”ti.
segments.thag19.1:56.3: Gāthāyo tattha paññāsa, puna pañca ca uttarīti.
